doc: Slack-style conversation components: a message, a thread, and a channel's history.

components.name: Segment
components.doc: One styled run of a message body: plain, bold, italic, struck, code, a mention, a channel reference or a link.

messageDocs.name: open
messageDocs.doc: Report this segment's URL upwards; a link segment cannot navigate by itself.

messageDocs.name: segClass
messageDocs.doc: The utility classes this run's flags add up to.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The literal text of the run.

fields.name: link
fields.doc: This run is a link; clicking it emits openLink.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: Where the link points. Reported, never followed.

inits.name: link
inits.doc: A link — clicking it emits openLink rather than navigating.

components.name: RichText
components.doc: A message body: a flat list of styled segments, rendered as one run of text.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: The runs that make up this body, in order.

inits.name: mixed
inits.doc: Every segment style in one body.

components.name: Reaction
components.doc: One emoji reaction with its count. Clicking it toggles your own and tells whoever is above.

messageDocs.name: toggle
messageDocs.doc: Add or take back your reaction, and report it upwards.

fields.name: reacted
fields.doc: Whether you are one of them.

inits.name: mine
inits.doc: One you are already part of.

components.name: Message
components.doc: A single message: who wrote it, when, its rich-text body and its reactions. Compact styling is what a threaded reply uses.

messageDocs.name: authorLabel
messageDocs.doc: The author as @name.

messageDocs.name: channelLabel
messageDocs.doc: The channel as #name.

messageDocs.name: hasChannel
messageDocs.doc: Whether to show the channel badge — a reply never does.

messageDocs.name: timeLabel
messageDocs.doc: The clock time, sliced out of createdAt.

fields.name: channelName
fields.doc: The channel it was posted in.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.doc: ISO 8601 timestamp, as it arrived. No clock is read.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The rich-text body. Accepts a RichText object or a bare segment list.

fields.name: compact
fields.doc: Reply styling: tighter, and no channel badge.

inits.name: reply
inits.doc: The same message as a threaded reply: compact, no channel badge.

inits.name: empty
inits.doc: Nobody, nothing — what an unfilled placeholder looks like.

components.name: Thread
components.doc: A root message and its replies, with the replies foldable.

messageDocs.name: toggle
messageDocs.doc: Fold or unfold the replies.

messageDocs.name: setExpanded
messageDocs.doc: Fold or unfold from outside — what a channel's expand-all sends.

messageDocs.name: hasReplies
messageDocs.doc: Whether there are any replies.

messageDocs.name: replyLabel
messageDocs.doc: The fold button's caret and count.

fields.name: root
fields.doc: The message the thread hangs off.

fields.name: replies
fields.doc: The replies, oldest first. Each is forced compact.

components.name: ChannelHistory
components.doc: One channel's conversations: a header, a filter box, an ordering toggle and the threads themselves.

messageDocs.name: setQuery
messageDocs.doc: Narrow the stream to threads whose text contains this.

messageDocs.name: toggleOrder
messageDocs.doc: Flip between newest-first and oldest-first.

messageDocs.name: expandAll
messageDocs.doc: Unfold every thread currently shown.

messageDocs.name: collapseAll
messageDocs.doc: Fold every thread currently shown.

messageDocs.name: openLink
messageDocs.doc: A segment somewhere below asked for a URL to be opened.

messageDocs.name: reacted
messageDocs.doc: A reaction somewhere below was toggled.

messageDocs.name: channelLabel
messageDocs.doc: The channel as #name.

messageDocs.name: memberLabel
messageDocs.doc: The member count as a sentence.

messageDocs.name: orderLabel
messageDocs.doc: The ordering toggle's label.

messageDocs.name: countLabel
messageDocs.doc: How many threads are shown, of how many.

messageDocs.name: hasError
messageDocs.doc: Whether the error banner shows.

messageDocs.name: isEmpty
messageDocs.doc: Whether the empty-state line shows.

fields.name: memberCount
fields.doc: How many people are in it.

fields.name: threads
fields.doc: The conversations currently shown — filtered and ordered.

fields.name: query
fields.doc: The filter text. Empty shows everything.

fields.name: newestFirst
fields.doc: Order by root timestamp, newest first.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: Show this as an error banner. Empty shows none.

fields.name: lastAction
fields.doc: The last thing a child reported, shown in the footer.
